text: At an all-girls school in Malaysia, twelve-year-old Zaffan dances in the bathroom, wears a bra and plays in a jungle stream with her friends Farah and Mariam. Then [her first period arrives|trigger|the body changing], her skin breaks out, [her nails start to fall away|images|wounded and changing bodies], and she glimpses [a pink-eyed jungle woman from an old warning tale|origin|old beliefs and legends] that no one else can see. As jealous classmates turn on her and the school calls in [a publicity-hungry faith healer|who_suffers|the guilty punished], Zaffan feels [claws and stripes rising in her|threat|the body turning monstrous].
